title: Conditional Grafana Webhook Routing to Cut Duplicate Voice Alerts
description: Learn how to configure Grafana webhooks to route critical alerts to WakeUp Dev, reducing duplicate voice calls and on‑call overhead while using unlimited seats and pay‑per‑alert.
author: Enrique Drack
topic: Conditional Grafana Webhook Routing to Cut Duplicate Voice Alerts

blocks.text: Grafana can send a raw JSON payload to any HTTP endpoint. By adding custom annotations or tags to an alert rule you can control which alerts should trigger a voice call. For example, only alerts tagged critical or urgent will be forwarded to WakeUp Dev.

When the webhook fires, the payload is transformed into the WakeUp Dev format and posted to https://api.wakeupdev.com/v1/alert. The API key is passed in the x-api-key header, and the body contains the alert message, severity, and any metadata needed for routing.

items: **Reduced duplicate voice calls**: Only critical alerts trigger a call, preventing the same issue from ringing multiple on‑call members.
**Cost control**: Unlimited seats mean every team member can be on‑call without extra per‑seat fees, and pay‑per‑alert keeps voice costs predictable.
**Simplified escalation**: The webhook can include a route field that maps to a specific on‑call rotation, eliminating manual triage.
**Lower alert fatigue**: Voice ACKs and digit‑1 acknowledgment reduce the need for multiple notification channels.
